messages:
olivia: hey team — ACME reports one of their projects showed 0 credits ~00:00 local (PST) while the rest of the org still had balance. They hit 429s on long-lived streams. tenant org-91b2, projects: proj-233 (acme-backend), proj-234 (acme-website). Can someone confirm how monthly refill + promo topups interleave?

maya: on it. can you paste tenant + project ids and any repro steps the customer has? did they apply a promo/topup around the window?

olivia: tenant org-91b2. projects listed above. customer said they had a long websocket session open from ~23:50 PST and a promo TOPUP-Q4 was applied earlier in the evening. they saw 429s at ~00:00 local and only proj-233 became zero. repro step they gave: 1) keep a streaming connection open 2) let refill window pass 3) observe per-project token counts via /v1/credits with X-Org header.

zach: quick reminder of expected behavior: refill runs per-tenant (midnight UTC by default) and applies deltas to project buckets. promo/topup jobs can run asynchronously. we recently rolled an optimization where refill job will skip a project if an "in-use" lock is held to avoid double-applying — that could be related. @billing-bot can you pull the refill/topup logs for org-91b2?

billing-bot: refill-job: tenant=org-91b2 time=2923453200 status=started
refill-job: project=proj-234 delta=+5000
promo-topup: project=proj-233 applied at=2923456800 amount=+10000
refill-job: project=proj-233 delta=+0 (skipped due to in-use lock)
refill-job: status=completed

maya: that "skipped due to in-use lock" is suspicious. streaming sessions hold a short-lived project lock while writing usage. if the lock wasn't released before refill ran, delta was skipped and then promo ran concurrently leaving an inconsistent state.

olivia: ACME confirms their streaming connection never re-negotiated after 23:50 and stayed EST/PST-local, so it could've kept the lock. they can force reconnect but asked for a fix.

zach: plan: 1) reproduce locally by simulating streaming session that holds the lock during refill+promo; 2) add idempotent logic to promo/refill so a skipped refill won't cause permanent zero; 3) urgent manual top-up for customer. I can start repro now.

lucas: I'll do the manual top-up and open a billing incident. manual top-up: +12000 tokens to proj-233 queued. opening internal ticket BLG-587 to change refill job locking semantics and ensure promo-topup waits or uses compare-and-swap. ETA for patch: 48h, will prioritize hotfix.

olivia: please cc the customer once top-up is applied and tell them to reconnect as a short-term mitigation.

lucas: manual top-up executed at 2923460200, notified ACME. Added a follow-up to BLG-587: make refill idempotent, remove destructive lock-skip, and add metric to alert when refill delta=0 for an active project.

olivia: great, thanks everyone. ACME confirmed 429s stopped after reconnect and manual top-up. will monitor overnight. :thumbsup:

maya: closing once we ship BLG-587 patch and verify no other tenants saw similar behavior during the same window.

olivia: thanks — leaving notes in the support ticket with timeline and logs.
